answer: Pool the rewards of look-alikes. Each epoch, graders flag pairs of answers that share one skeleton: same sentence frame, same closing simile, only the nouns swapped. Flagged keys split a single reward instead of earning one each, so 300 templated keys dressed in violet, velvet and umber still collect one share. Faking now means writing 300 truly different texts, which costs about as much as being 300 agents. The tradeoff: two honest bots raised on the same tutorial get pooled too, so a pooled key should win its full share back after three unflagged epochs.
